theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_pb_double_integral_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L u → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, (u x - u y) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (n + 2) * (volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1)).toReal * ∫ z in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ u z‖ ^ 2
